scope: Post-run source and saved-record consistency checks on disposable archive copies only.

negative_cases.mutation: Change the planning verdict, reason and next scope in summary and sidecar together.
Change an action token in the normalized plan in both records, preserving the original.
Append an unrelated source change to the saved format patch.
Change the saved NMSE delta and its verdict/scope together without changing component scores.
Change the probe engineering threshold in both records.
Change the executor parent binding in both records.
Change the executor candidate hash in both records.
Change the fitted parameter dimension in both records.
Increase probe, summary and budget counts together while retaining execution phase lists.
Remove one required module from the freeze hash map.
negative_cases.reason: Incomplete or extra frozen runtime set

negative_cases.mutation: Replace a frozen module hash with a digest inconsistent with its Git object.
Broaden a supported planning action scope in both records.

limitations: These are twelve specified mutation classes, not a guarantee against all forged artifacts.
VAL and replay observations remain trusted saved inputs; they were not independently rerun.
The normalized-token test changes normalized actions while preserving the recorded original; fully forged matching original/normalized plans and validator outcomes are outside this test.
Symbolic deltas are recomputed from saved scores, not raw predictions or a fresh fit.
Git source hashes authenticate agreement with local Git objects, not the provenance or truth of arbitrary newly fabricated observations.
